title: NerfJockey
body:
# 🚀 NerfJockey: Baby Zombie Fix 🚀

## 📜 Overview

Tired of those impossibly fast, tiny terrors ruining your early game? **NerfJockey** is the essential Quality of Life (QoL) plugin for any SMP or Survival server, giving control back to the players by fixing the most frustrating mob in Minecraft: the Baby Zombie.

We didn't just slow them down—we made them **fair**\!

-----

## ✨ Features ✨

**1\. Adjustable Speed Nerf**

Baby Zombies are known for their insane speed. **NerfJockey** allows server owners to precisely reduce their movement speed using a multiplier. No more outrunning you to the ends of the Earth\!

**2\. Enlarged Hitbox Fix (The Game Changer)**

The number one complaint is how hard they are to hit. Our innovative fix attaches an invisible, larger proxy entity to the zombie, making your swings **connect reliably**, even though the mob is still visually small.

  * Reliable Hits: No more missing swings—you hit what you see\!
  * Seamless Integration: The proxy silently follows the zombie using a dedicated asynchronous task for perfect tracking.

**3\. Adjustable Follow Range Nerf**

Control how far these pests can spot you. Reduce their aggression radius to give players more time to react and escape before a chase even starts.

-----

## ⚙️ Configuration & Commands ⚙️

Customize the balance of your server effortlessly via the `config.yml` file.

| Setting | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `movement-speed-multiplier` | `0.75` | Reduces speed by 25%. Set to `1.0` to disable. |
| `follow-range-multiplier` | `0.70` | Reduces detection range by 30%. |
| `enlarge-hitbox-active` | `true` | Enables/Disables the crucial larger hitbox fix. |
| `hitbox-y-offset` | `0.0` | Advanced setting for fine-tuning vertical hit registration. |

-----
